added_lines: 703 time change - reminder! winter time officially begins this weekend with clocks going back one hour at 2 am on sunday morning. enjoy your extra hour of rest! visitation of the sick & housebound fr sean will visit the sick and housebound during this week between late morning and early afternoon. tuesday 27th october - beragh wednesday 28th october - drumduff & sixmilecross thursday 29th october - seskinore & roscavey feasts of all saints and all souls next sunday (1st november) the church celebrates the feast of all saints. annual november novena for the dead - all are encouraged to join in the annual novena for the holy souls beginning on the feast of all saints until the 9th november. novena cards, and candles (£4 each) for lighting on your family graves during the days of the novena are available in each of the churches this weekend. monday 2nd november , on the feast of all souls there will be a special mass commemorating all those who have died in the parish since last november in the church of the immaculate conception, beragh at 7.30 pm. all are encouraged to come and join in prayer for the happy repose of the souls of all who have died. november dead lists should be handed in next weekend. masses will be offered throughout the year for all those enrolled on the november dead list. offertory promise 11th & 18th october 2026 envelopes: £ 1,538.00 loose collection: £ 441.18 candles: £ 164.54 mission sunday: £ 465.00 priest’s dues: £ 610.00 total: £ 3,218.72 thank you to all those parishioners who continue to support the parish. beragh
